events.text_en: Họa Tinh Đường builds its soot kilns, the Mặc Yên, among the vermilion pines where Chi Hương Trấn burned, and burns pine pitch for ink.
Kỷ Thu Tịch, founder of Họa Tinh Đường, dies at the painting table at 317; her grand-niece Kỷ Ngân Chúc takes the Hall and swears an oath on a cedar box.
Thích Minh Thư of the Pivot's archive asks Hàn Thủy Mặc for a night's ink, for a guard roll of Tinh Tủy Mạch.
